candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML crawl of hub + its 6 child listing pages; diff child link lists weekly
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search + fetch of hub page, link enumeration

candidates.source_name: MNB Ajánlások (supervisory recommendations register)
candidates.why_relevant: Numbered MNB recommendations (e.g. 5/2023. (VI.23.), 26/2018. (VIII.16.) on payment service operational/security risk) each carry an explicit effective date (hatálybalépés) and addressee set — the core binding-by-supervision expectation layer for banks and PSPs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape listing table (number/date/title/PDF link), fetch PDFs, extract 'hatályba lép' date and addressee section

candidates.source_name: MNB Vezetői körlevelek (executive circulars)

candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable change feeds published by the emitting authority itself — the cheapest, most robust ingestion channel for supervisory/market-supervision announcements and new publications.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Hungarian for an MNB public-consultation register (társadalmi egyeztetés / véleményezés / ajánlástervezet). No general-purpose MNB consultation hub surfaced on mnb.hu; the only structured draft-publication surface found is aszp.mnb.hu/rendelettervezetek (reporting decrees only). Consultation on ajánlás drafts appears to run through password-protected channels with industry associations, and via ad-hoc 'szakmai konzultáció' news items.
negative_findings.result_summary: Consultation visibility on the MNB site is partial and event-driven, not a register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Forward-looking A3 signal (pre-publication drafts, comment deadlines) is structurally weaker for MNB soft law than for the EU authorities; the felügyeleti hírek feed and industry associations must compensate.

negative_findings.description: Reporting found that draft recommendations are made available to financial organisations for consultation via password-protected internet access through their interest-representation bodies (érdekképviseleti szervek).
negative_findings.result_summary: Draft-stage consultation material is behind credentialed access we should not attempt.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Do not plan any collection against gated MNB consultation areas; route this coverage through published outputs and association members instead.

negative_findings.description: Searched hu for 'szabályozási hírlevél' / 'felügyeleti hírlevél'. Only historical (2013-era) supervisory newsletters surfaced; no evidence of a current, regularly published MNB supervisory newsletter product.
negative_findings.result_summary: Assume no active MNB regulatory newsletter; rely on RSS /rss/11.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids building a collector against a discontinued channel.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetch-verified beyond three hub pages (felugyeleti-szabalyozo-eszkozok, /rss). All other URLs come from search-result metadata and are recorded with confidence scores, not liveness claims.
negative_findings.result_summary: Liveness must be established by the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false 'verified' status propagating into the source registry.

coverage_gaps.description: The decisions-and-rulings search (határozatok és végzések keresése) is a form-driven application; no static index or documented API was identified, so bulk historical harvesting of supervisory findings and fines is unproven.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the search page's network calls for a JSON endpoint; if none, budget a headless-browser paging collector keyed on date range and sector.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage of pre-publication drafts is limited to reporting decrees (aszp rendelettervezetek). Draft ajánlások and vezetői körlevelek have no observed public draft register.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add industry associations (Magyar Bankszövetség, and any payments/fintech association) as a companion cell — they receive drafts and often comment publicly.

coverage_gaps.description: Effective dates (hatálybalépés) and submission deadlines live inside PDF bodies and per-year reporting tables, not in listing metadata, so link-diffing alone will not yield a deadline calendar.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a HU-language PDF extraction rule set for 'hatályba lép', 'alkalmazandó', 'legkésőbb', '… munkanapig', 'tárgyhónapot követő'.

coverage_gaps.description: MNB emits instruments across at least four hosts/trees: www.mnb.hu/felugyelet, www.mnb.hu/penzforgalom, aszp.mnb.hu, zoldpenzugyek.mnb.hu, plus the legacy /archivum CMS. A single-tree crawler will silently under-collect.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define the MNB collection target as a multi-host set with per-host crawl rules; assert coverage by cross-checking each new felügyeleti-hír against the host trees.

coverage_gaps.description: MNB states recommendations are available in Hungarian; the EN mirror is partial and lags. English-only monitoring would miss most instruments and nearly all effective dates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat HU as the system of record; use EN only for terminology reconciliation and cross-checks.

brief: MNB is the primary emission point for Hungarian banking and payments supervisory rules, but it does not publish them from one place: binding-by-supervision soft law (ajánlás, vezetői körlevél, módszertani kézikönyv) sits under mnb.hu/felugyelet/szabalyozas/felugyeleti-szabalyozo-eszkozok, legally binding reporting decrees and their drafts sit on the separate aszp.mnb.hu portal, payments-authority inspection criteria sit under mnb.hu/penzforgalom, and green instruments sit on zoldpenzugyek.mnb.hu, with a legacy /archivum CMS holding PSZÁF-era history. The highest-value low-cost ingestion channels are MNB's own RSS feeds (felügyeleti hírek /rss/11, piacfelügyelet /rss/23, kiadványok /rss/7), which reliably fire on 'Új MNB ajánlás megjelenése' events; the highest-value forward signals are aszp.mnb.hu/rendelettervezetek and the annual ellenőrzési terv. Two structural weaknesses define this cell: there is no public consultation register for draft recommendations (drafts circulate to industry bodies behind password access), and effective dates and reporting deadlines are buried in PDF bodies rather than listing metadata, so a Hungarian-language extraction ruleset for 'hatályba lép' / 'legkésőbb … munkanapig' is a prerequisite for any deadline calendar.
